# Flake0 summarize action

Posts one comment per run on the pull request with the [`classify`](../classify/README.md)
verdicts of every failed job:

```
flake0: Integration tests failing due to a mix of test issues and flakiness. Run summary

| Category    | Count | Failing tests                                   |
|-------------|-------|-------------------------------------------------|
| Test issues | 1     | test_build_and_deploy                           |
| Flaky       | 1     | test_tls_expiration                             |

To fix
- test_build_and_deploy: empty charm URL error. Recommendation: fix test.
  Suggested fix: build the charm first.

AI-generated by flake0. It can be wrong, so check before acting on it.
```

Each test name links to its job's summary on the run page. Only charm bugs and test issues get
a line under "To fix".

Rows go worst first: charm bugs (`code_regression`, `code_preexisting`, `workload_defect`),
test issues (`test_defect`), flaky (`environment_infra`, `external_service`, `dependency_drift`),
then no verdict (`INCONCLUSIVE`, `unknown`, or no verdict at all).

Part of the **Flake0** AI debugging suite for CI tests.

## Usage

In the test job, after classify. Each failed job uploads its verdict and rewrites the comment
from every verdict of the run so far:

```yaml
permissions:
  pull-requests: write
steps:
  # ...
  - name: Classify failure
    id: classify
    if: failure()
    uses: canonical/flake0/.github/actions/classify@main
    with: # ...
  - name: Update flake0 PR comment
    if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
    uses: canonical/flake0/.github/actions/summarize@main
    with:
      leg-id: ${{ matrix.name }}  # unique per matrix entry
      job-name: ${{ matrix.name }}
      verdict-path: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.verdict-path }}
      job-id: ${{ job.check_run_id }}  # links each test to this job's summary
```

A failed job whose classify step was skipped or failed shows up under "No verdict". A job that
fails before this step, or whose runner is lost, doesn't show up at all. Green runs, other
events and fork pull requests (no secrets, so no verdicts) get no comment. A re-run attempt gets
its own comment. The action never fails the job.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `leg-id` | `github.job` | Unique per matrix entry, used in the artifact name |
| `job-name` | `github.job` | Job name when classify left no verdict |
| `verdict-path` | `""` | The classify step's `verdict-path` output |
| `job-id` | `""` | `job.check_run_id`, so the comment links each test to this job's summary |

## Notes

### Concurrent jobs

Two jobs can update the comment at the same moment, and one edit can be lost. Every update
rebuilds the comment from all verdicts uploaded so far, so the next update repairs it. If two
jobs both post a first comment, the next update deletes the newer one.

### Untrusted text

Verdicts come from a model reading pull request logs. The comment shows known labels only, and
other text as single lines, with HTML escaped and `@` mentions broken. It only edits or deletes
bot comments that start with this run's marker. Links, images, `#` references and code span
breaks are escaped too.

## Development

```bash
# from the repo root. tests/golden holds the comment and job summary format.
pytest tests/test_summarize.py
ruff check .github/actions/summarize/scripts/summarize.py
shellcheck -S style .github/actions/summarize/scripts/run.sh

# render a comment from downloaded verdict artifacts
python3 .github/actions/summarize/scripts/summarize.py --verdicts verdicts --run-url URL \
  --marker '<!-- flake0-summary run=1 attempt=1 -->' --out body.md
```
